info.schedule: Online, usually a minimum-bid round in July or August and a no-reserve round in the fall
info.note: Catalogs, inspector notes, photos and results come from Title Check's tax-sale.info, which runs the auctions for most Michigan treasurers. County value is twice the State Equalized Value (SEV), since Michigan sets SEV at half of market value.

parcels.desc: Very attractive parcel in the newer Pentwater Woods subdivision. Private roads infer that there are association fees here to maintain them. Likely to be deed restrictions as well that you may want to investigate prior to bidding.. Nice newer homes here. About 3/4 of an acre in size.

This sale includes two tax parcels, combined into one sale lot. The parcels are located on a platted street that appears to have been privately improved and are not county maintained as far as we can tell. The south lot is mostly open and cleared, but toward the north end of it there is the beginning of a rustic homestead/campsite that carries on into the second parcel. It was clearly still occupi...
Vacant parcel on 1st St in Mears. This parcel is adjacent to auction lot 5604. ~0.72 acres in size. Clear and grass covered parcel being maintained by the neighboring house.

Modern one-story manufactured home on two parcels in Mears near the Silver Lake recreation area. Attached 1.5 car garage. This property is OCCUPIED and the owner states that she is going to attempt to repurchase it at the sale. Appears to be well kept and clean. Because of the occupancy, we were not able to review the parcel in detail. There is an Affidavit of Affixture on record Liber 2019 Page 1...
Parcel is about 3/4 of an acre. On the south side of the village of Ferry on a quiet gravel sidestreet. Parcel is level and open, with well drained gravelly sandy soils. Three platted lots.

Older wood frame home in the quiet community of Hesperia in far eastern Oceana County. Asphalt faux-brick siding. Older shingle roof. Yard is overgrown and there are several inoperable vehicles and other items around the yard. There is a garage/storage outbuilding that is also quite overgrown. The house *appears* to be abandoned, however upon closer inspection we discovered lights on and indicator...

Older 1.5 story wood frame home a couple miles due east of New Era. Sits about 15 feet above road grade on a rolling 5 acre parcel. A couple-three inoperable vehicles in the yard with minor debris. House and yard overgrown. Home has a steel roof that looks to be in pretty decent condition. There is ceiling damage in the main floor bathroom. Uncertain of the age of that damage as it relates to roof...

Fairly new, poorly maintained single wide on a 1/2 acre lot. Located at the end of a cul-de-sac. Backs up to US31 freeway and the sound is pretty noticeable. Some of the skirting is in disarray, which suggests probable plumbing freeze damage to repair. The yard is overgrown and there is some clutter to dispose of. Inside, the house is about knee deep in debris of the "not too stinky, just dirty" t...

This is an older single-wide mobile home located in Oceana Shores, just NE of Rothbury. This property was still occupied at the time of our visit in mid-June. Has some replacement window and vinyl siding upgrades. Minimal exterior debris.

The subject property is .86 acre in size and is located on the north side of Range Street east of the N Ridge Road intersection about 7.5 miles south of Pentwater MI. The property has lot dimensions of 120 feet X 135 feet and is comprised of somewhat poorly drained fine sandy soil with 0 to 3% slopes. The parcel is adjacent to 5 private landowners and is zoned within the RR – Resort Residential Di...

~0.80 acre parcel on Monroe Road, about 2 miles east of Pentwater. There is an old wood-frame house and a detached one-car garage here. The home has been unoccupied for years. The abandoned car in the driveway has tags dated 2008. This is essentially a shell that will need all new mechanical components and resurfacing. A good accumulation of (non-stinky) debris inside and out. The roof has some de...

We did not view the interior of this property, as we believe that it is still under the control of relatives of the former owner. They appear to have personal property, including vehicles and machinery, here. The windows and doors were secured, so we could not see in, but the few peeks we could gather suggest that the property is probably dirty, but merchantable. This is very level land, and rough...

Three adjacent lots in Lake Michigan Shores. The parcels located in this platted neighborhood have deeded walkable access to the Lake Michigan Shoreline via two 10 ft wide paths located off Lakeshore Drive. Please see attached plat map for reference. Cedar Point County Park is also located adjacent to this neighborhood to the north and is a public 2.5 Acre park on Lake Michigan with shaded picnic ...

We aren't certain if this is a natural gas pipeline station or if there is underground storage associated with this. Two steel data huts in solid condition, and a third structure that is a little torn up. No identifying placards to operate either the operator or the facility identification. We aren't horribly concerned with the contamination prospects at this one, as there are no open tanks or geo...

3 acre parcel contains some discombobulated oil / gas production equipment and bulk storage tanks, marked "TransAmerican". Typically these facilities have markers identifying the operator and facility detail. There is no such marker here. Appears to have been dormant years. Maybe decades. Lots of scrap metal here. It has been stripped of compressors and other valuable gear. Mostly piping, tanks an...

Late century doublewide on a block foundation crawlspace. 2 bedrooms, 1 bath. Detached 2+2 car garage about 50 feet to the north. The roof on this house is shady... but curiously, it isn't leaking inside (yet). There is damage to shingles, and the fascia and soffits need attention soon. The electric service has been cannibalized. Floor coverings are missing in places, and there is a spot in the re...

Older mobile home with a roof over and frame addition. Wall-to-wall garbage that was pretty ripe when we were there in early June. Wood frame storage shed and lean-to out back also full of stinky. Structurally, this one really isn't too bad, but there is some decay at eaves and fascia in places. But she is a really dirty girl and needs a bath before you can be sure. This one is pretty ripe, so you...

This is a vacant parcel at the Lake Tahoe assocaition east of Rothbury. There is a camper on this property that we do not have title to. This property appears to still be occupied, as there were people around when we passed by in early June on a Saturday afternoon. This property is subject to the association fees and deed restrictions of the Lake Tahoe Property Owners Association

Older mobile home on 2 acres In Otto Township, east of Rothbury. Comes with appliances (range in the front yard, fridge out back). Has a guest cottage with an open-air design. Several skylights. Family recreation area in the front yard. A carefully curated collection of rubbish that includes most of two or three cars, a motor home, a boat, a riding tractor, and lots of burned garbage. The value he...

This property is a vacant ~2.46 acre lot that sits behind properties on E Skeels. There is no known legal access to this property, so buyer beware. If planning to develop the land please contact the local government unit to get more information on possible building restrictions. E.g. Minimum Sq. footage requirement.

Fairly new manufactured log cabin is located at the Double JJ Resort, near Rothbury. This is the area of the annual "Electric Forest Festival" that draws tens of thousands, but otherwise is fairly tranquil. This property was occupied at the time of our visit in early June, so we could not view it in detail, but it appears to be well-kept and merchantable in every way. You may be able to locate det...

A really gorgeous parcel ! Vacant 80-acre parcel that is surrounded by 7 private landowners and the US Forest Service. The USFS was contacted but has no interest in acquiring the property from the State of MI.
